profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dropbox Docsend
profile.summary: I am a computer scientist with a passion for creating new and interesting software. I have experience in C, C++, Java, C#, React, Ruby on Rails, Rust, and TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project lead for a complete ground-up rewrite of the DocSend content library, including RFC authoring and cross-team architectural alignment.
Acted as a communication bridge between engineering, product, and design—unblocking teammates by clarifying requirements and ensuring consistent direction.
Collaborated with product to create and validate new user-facing help documentation for the new content page
Led internationalization efforts for the entire DocSend application, including building custom TypeScript and Ruby tooling for automatic string wrapping and extraction.
Hackweek competition winner: built an Electron app with AI-driven focus tools within first 3 months.
Mentored a summer intern and served as team lead for a group of contractors, improving accessibility compliance from 65% to 95%.
Built an AI prototype leveraging OpenAI GPT APIs for document summarization and automatic video captioning.
Led a successful migration of the company marketing site from WordPress to Next.js completed 1 month ahead of schedule.
Increased marketing site signup conversions by 16% through implementation of an updated design.
Partnered with legal & compliance teams to ensure features aligned with GDPR, CCPA, and internal privacy requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · Back-End Web Development · Computer Science · Software Design · Data Structures · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated older code to newer standards and libraries.
Mentored two junior software engineers to get them up to speed quickly with the code base.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · Back-End Web Development · Computer Science · Software Design · Data Structures · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integral in implementation of features from client requests.
Streamlined continuous integration test runner to decrease time for test runs by 33 percent.
Updated existing test suite to Jest for javascript testing.
Worked closely with team members on creating an integration with ADP Workforce Now
Quickly learned Ruby on Rails to work on the development of the web application.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · Back-End Web Development · Computer Science · Software Design · Data Structures · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a REST API with node JS and express backed by a MySQL database along with a react frontend that displayed stats from a flight simulator.
Used knowledge of DirectX and C++ to add custom rendering to the inside of an F-15 cockpit inside of a flight simulator.
Led development of a team of 3 in Unity3D to create a standalone flight simulator using C#. 
Used hand tracking with unity to create realistic driving in VR. 
Created a web socket server for vital communication between AFSIM DLL and Prepar3D DLL.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Computer Science · Software Design · Problem Solving

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Software engineering internship.
Quickly learned React Native to assist in the development of a React Native application.
Integrated new features, fixed differences in IOS and Android. 
Created/updated unit tests for new code.
Updated legacy library code from VB6 to C#, including code to draw labels for prescriptions
